description: A teardrop location pin with a ring at its centre points down toward a low arch. Two shorter arcs curve outward on either side of its tip, forming a broken half-ring around the pin.
A circle representing the earth holds two wavy coastline outlines. A long S-shaped coast runs down the left of centre and a shorter bent coast crosses the upper right, both meeting the rim.
A globe with a single continent shape sits inside a curved meridian arc on a tilted axis, with short axis stubs at the upper left and lower right. A short post rises from a flat rounded base.
A circle is crossed by a horizontal equator line and two curved meridians that bow outward from top to bottom. The right edge of the outline is slightly irregular.
A circle with a slightly irregular outline is crossed by one horizontal line and two straight vertical lines. Together they divide it into a six-part grid.
A ring holds a smaller ring at its centre. Four short tick marks cross the outer ring at the top, bottom, left and right.
Three teardrop location pins overlap: two side by side at the top and a third in front of them at the centre. The front pin's tip extends below into a short stem.
